title: Mixed Event — Beyond The Dream of That Day — Episode6 The Princess Of Smiles

meta.Event: Beyond The Dream of That Day
meta.Event Outline: After putting on a successful solo show, MORE MORE JUMP! starts thinking about their next goal. During that time, they're offered a chance to appear on TV. Everyone is excited to hear the news, except Haruka, who doesn't quite share in their optimism...

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
Alright, this is the front row!
To celebrate us meeting today, you get a special invitation♪

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
That's right!
A very special invitation!

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
Oh, by the way...
What's your name?

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
Haruka! That's so perfect!
You're just the cutest thing, but you also have this air of coolness about you!

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: Anyway, I've gotta go on stage and blow everyone away. In the meantime, while you wait for your mom and dad to come, I hope you enjoy the show!

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting, everyone!
Welcome to the special release show for my new single!

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: Those who've been following me and those who are seeing me for the first time... I hope you all enjoy the show!

rows.Speaker: Girlfriend
rows.Line:
Hm? They're having an idol concert?
But there aren't that many people...

rows.Speaker: Boyfriend
rows.Line: Yeah, she doesn't seem all that famous, but I'm seeing some people who look like loyal fans...

rows.Speaker: Boyfriend
rows.Line: But she's a pretty good singer.

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line:
(She's singing and dancing...
And I really love how frilly and pretty her clothes are.)

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: (People are starting to stop and watch her performance...)

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: “And so, the Princess was able to use her beautiful smile to spread love and courage to people all over.”

rows.Speaker: Old Lady
rows.Line:
Hehe. She's very cute.
It's so encouraging to see young people doing their best.

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line:
(*Gasp*
Everyone's clapping along to her song...)

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line:
(Sh-Should I join them...?
But it's a bit embarrassing...)

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line:
(She's clapping her hands...
Am I supposed to go along with her...?)

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: It looks like we have a pretty decent crowd now, so I'd like to move to my next song... While I'm at it, why don't I call today's special guest to the stage?

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: You did a perfect job of clapping along to my song just now! So...

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
Let's dance on stage together!
How about it?!

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
No problem!
We'll do something simple! I'm sure you'll get it in no time, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
Okay, so you kick and step!
And after that, turn!
Think you can do it, Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's it!
After you turn, you tilt your head slightly and strike a cute pose!

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
Did you all see that?!
Isn't she the cutest?!
I'm already head over heels for her!

rows.Speaker: Boyfriend
rows.Line: Yeah, she really knows how to draw you in.

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: Alright, let's try dancing along to a song! When the part for this dance starts, I'll say, “Go.” After I do, everyone, move along with Haruka as she dances!

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: (Will she like it if I clapped along again like I did just now...?)

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line:
(What's going on...?
This warm feeling's been welling up inside of me...)

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: (So much that it's like I'm about to burst...)

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: (Oh... I'm in perfect sync with the music...)

rows.Speaker: Old Lady
rows.Line: Oh, look at her. That's adorable. She's dancing like there's no tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Girlfriend
rows.Line:
Hey, check out that girl!
She's so little, but an amazing dancer!

rows.Speaker: Boyfriend
rows.Line:
Haha. Yeah, she is.
I can't help but smile while watching her.

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: (They all like the way I'm dancing...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe...
If only it were easier to make you smile, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm always making Mom feel sad and frown...)

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: (But that old lady, that man, that woman... People I don't know at all... They're smiling...)

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: (Seeing them smile makes me feel so happy...)

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line:
(This warmth...
I wasn't sure what it was before, but it's taken me over...)

rows.Speaker: Old Lady
rows.Line: What a beautiful smile. It's almost as bright as the sun.

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line:
(Oh, I guess I am...
I mean, that nice lady, the others... They're all sparkling...)

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: You guys all did an amazing job!

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
Including you, Haruka.
You finally smiled...

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: Everyone smiled when they watched me dance, right? Does that mean I did okay...?

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
Absolutely!
You were awesome! And your smile gets a perfect score!

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: Haruka, I think you have what it takes to become an idol. I mean, your smile gave me so much hope!

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
Yup!
The hope to believe in a better tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: Watching you filled me with so much of that hope, Haruka. You made me think, “I can't let her hog all the glory! I've gotta keep trying my best tomorrow!”

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's right!
So, in my eyes, you're already an idol who's able to spread hope to others!

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: Are idols supposed to give people hope by smiling...?

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
Yeah!
That's an idol's most important job!

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: So, in order to spread more and more hope to everyone... To get them to believe in a better tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: Wanna dance with me during my next song?
